Map and Set

Map stores key-value entries with keys of any type; Set stores unique values. Both iterate in
insertion order.

duplicates තබන්Jන් නැහැ. Objects keys Jලසත් භාවිත කළ හැකියි.

Interview question: When is Map preferable to a plain object?
Answer: When arbitrary key types, direct size, and convenient entry iteration are useful.
Practice: Count word frequencies with a Map and unique words with a Set.
